title: Clearer errors for malformed text requests
summary:
A maintenance day for text requests: clearer errors, tighter queue rules, and more backend tests.

The text API now returns JSON errors for invalid messages, and the OpenAI-compatible endpoint rejects an empty messages array with a 400 response. Handling for missing query parameters and omitted generation options also improved.

Image Pollinations referrers no longer bypass rate limiting, though they still bypass the request queue. Text request-delay bypass now follows Roblox-referrer classification rather than codes supplied with a request.

A new workflow runs affected text or image backend tests on pull requests, alongside added text-generation tests and coverage tooling. The text API also dropped qwen-coder from its model list and removed unused provider implementations.
